sections.heading: Belagavi's Dairy Network: BEMUL and Its Processing Units
paragraphs: Belagavi is best known industrially as a foundry and hydraulics base, a tradition that began more than a century ago with Babu Rao Pusalkar's first workshop in the city. For hygienic tube, though, the growing buyer is dairy. The Belagavi District Cooperative Milk Producers Societies Union (BEMUL), part of the Karnataka Milk Federation network, collects milk through hundreds of village cooperatives across the district's talukas.

In 2021 the federation reported that the Belagavi unit had a processing capacity of 1 lakh litres a day, with further 1 lakh litre units working at Gokak, Athani and Ramdurg and a 60,000 litre plant being set up at Raibag. Demand from neighbouring Goa was one reason the federation pushed for more dairy farming in the district.

sections.heading: A Mega Dairy in Belagavi: What It Means for Tube Buyers
paragraphs: BEMUL is now planning a mega dairy as part of an expansion aimed at cutting production costs and strengthening processing capacity, and in July 2026 it was working to acquire 25 acres of government land for the project. A new dairy of that kind is built around automated reception, pasteurisation, cultured products, and CIP stations that clean every line several times a day.

For the project's engineers and contractors the tube decision comes early. Milk and cream lines are normally 304L to ASTM A270. Salted products, whey and hot caustic CIP supply call for 316L. Electropolished tube is worth specifying on cultured-product lines such as curd and buttermilk, on flavoured milk, and on the CIP return legs that prove a circuit is clean.

sections.heading: Foundry and Hydraulics Shops Building Process Equipment
paragraphs: Belagavi's engineering base in Udyambag and Auto Nagar machines castings and hydraulic components for industry across India. Shops that fabricate tanks, skids or CIP units for dairy and food customers need sanitary tube cut to their drawings, with certificates they can pass on to the end user at handover. Engineering units with no product-contact work do not need a hygienic finish, and we will recommend the economical option where it fits.

sections.heading: What to Send With a Belagavi Dairy Tube Enquiry
bullets: The plant section for each size: reception, pasteurisation, cultured products, flavoured milk, CIP supply or CIP return.
OD × wall for each size, usually 1.65 mm wall dairy tube, with the metres needed per size.
Grade by duty: 304L for milk and cream, 316L for salted product, whey and hot CIP supply.
Finish: SF1 mechanical polish for general sanitary duty, or SF4 electropolished for cultured-product and CIP return lines.
Whether the order is for BEMUL's own team or a turnkey contractor, so certificates are addressed to the right party.
Every lot ships with an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to heat number, PMI on every length and a measured Ra report for electropolished tube.

sections.heading: Delivery to Belagavi
paragraphs: Belagavi is supplied by road from our Taloja MIDC works along the Mumbai–Bengaluru highway; dispatch and transit are confirmed in writing with each quotation.
